== Burn out ==

The entry for burn out specifies: '''Burning Out''' is the act of severing yourself from the One Power by accident.  I take issue with the "by accident."  Isn't it possible for a channeller male or female to burn themselves out ON PURPOSE by drawing too much power? -- [[Special:Contributions/158.145.224.33|158.145.224.33]] 20:47, October 26, 2010 (UTC)
